cookie.subtitle: Nhap cookie dang nhap cua cua hang. Ung dung se kiem tra cookie thuoc cua hang nao truoc khi luu.
cookie.step1: Cai tien ich Cookie-Editor trong Chrome va dang nhap Trung tam lien ket (affiliate.tiktok.com) cua cua hang nay trong Chrome.

cookie.step3: Dan vao o ben duoi, hoac chon tep .json da xuat.
cookie.step4: Voi nhieu cua hang, hay dang nhap, xuat va them tung cua hang rieng.
